case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests often praised the hotel's outdoor spaces, pools, family atmosphere and entertainment, and many noted comfortable beds and clean shared areas. Recurring negatives included that rooms are outdated and that buffet/meal options are limited or repetitive. Pool cleanliness and food quality drew mixed comments; a few isolated reviews mentioned poor Wi‑Fi, a rude staff member, lack of outlets and uncomfortable pillows.
